rules.text: Creatures have no eyes (the Mew is waiting on the owner).
Statues and sculptures are faceless or veiled.
Cross shapes become stars (finials, windows, decorations).
Every outfit is modest; hijab-friendly headwear exists.
Women's party dresses are visible only to female accounts.
Combat is magical: enemies shatter into light and petals, no blood.
Meshy models keep their natural size; only the palace is enlarged (x2.75).
Only the owner is the Mew; it is not in the pet menu and its voice is hidden until the reveal.
Creatures are original designs inspired by Pokemon, cartoons and myth, not copies.

templates.name: Harmony puzzle
templates.how: Pressure pads, mirrors, bells or beams that need several players at once
templates.why: Nobody can do it alone; people have to talk

templates.name: Race
templates.how: On foot, on creatures, in vehicles or on the flying ship through rings
templates.why: Quick fun with a winner, easy to join
templates.win: first across the line; everyone who finishes gets the shard

templates.name: Party game

templates.name: Escort
templates.how: Carry or guide something fragile together (a lantern, spirits, baby whales)
templates.win: the escorted thing arrives with light left

templates.name: Team gather and build
templates.how: Collect pieces and build something together (a cake layer, a bridge, an ice sculpture)
templates.why: Shared creation; each person adds a part

templates.name: Heart quiz and memory
templates.how: Questions about her and about each other, echo and photo memory games
templates.why: Friends learn about each other; deeply personal

story.macguffin: The Great Birthday Lantern, cracked into 32 star shards

acts.name: The ladies arrive
acts.summary: Female friends ride in through the waterfall gate, cross the bridge, explore the palace and dress up.

acts.name: Her surprise
acts.summary: She opens her link, rides in with the full aerial reveal, is welcomed with confetti, and the Mew bonds with her.

acts.name: The Hush falls
acts.summary: The men arrive by flying ship; the Hush cracks the lantern into 32 shards and greys the land.

acts.name: The 32 places
acts.summary: Free each head, befriend creatures, play the game, beat the challenge, win the shard; saved people go to the palace.

acts.name: Midnight
acts.summary: Final boss, then the roof opens, the floating theatre forms, the cake, and the Mew becomes the owner.
